content: Dissertation timeline A.1: c. 795/1393 Ibn Turka leaves Samarkand for Mecca and Cairo, Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī accompanying him; c. 795-810/1393-1408 he studies in Cairo under Akhlāṭī, al-Bulqīnī and others and 'remains abroad 15 years'; Akhlāṭī dies 799/1397; c. 810/1408 he returns to Isfahan. MK's footnote warns that some timeline dates and events are conjectured or approximate.
